simple.meaning: עֲדֻלָּם (ʻĂdullâm) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, and 2 more, beginning at Joshua 12:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲדֻלָּם (H5725) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֲדֻלָּם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עֲדֻלָּם (ʻĂdullâm) / H5725 is tracked through Joshua 12:15, Joshua 15:35, 1 Samuel 22:1, 2 Samuel 23:13. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: David therefore departed from there, and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah.

definitions.full: H5725. Adullam עֲדֻלָּם proper name, of a location old Canaanite city , ᵐ5 Οδολλαμ , with king Josh 12:15 (D), in the שְׁפֵלָה 15:35 (P; ᵐ5 L Αδαλαμ ), compare Micah 1:15 ; Neh 11:30 ; (re-)built by Rehod. according to 2Chr 11:17 ( Οδολαμ ); ׳ע מְעָרַת (read מְצָדַת מְצֻדַת, , see מְעָרָה below I. ערר ) 1Sam 22:1 ; 2Sam 23:13 ; 1Chr 11:15 ; site probably I`d-el-Mîye ( `Aid el-Ma ), approximately 13 miles west-southwest from Bethlehem, see GASm Geogr.229 Buhl Geogr.193 and references .
